question: A charged particle has specific charge magnitude $|\alpha|=|q|/m$ and is released from the origin with initial velocity $\vec v(0)=v_0\,\hat{i}$. There is no electric field. The magnetic field varies with position as $\vec B(x)=-B_0 x\,\hat{k}$, where $B_0>0$ is a constant (units: T/m). Motion is non-relativistic and radiation effects are neglected. Determine the maximum $x$-coordinate ($x_{max}>0$) reached by the particle.
